tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Page background and base surface. Text colours below name the grounds they sit on.

tokens.name: oat
tokens.usage: Raised surface: code chips, tags, quiet panels. Muted text on it is 4.57:1 in light and 4.48:1 in dark (see README, Not synced).

tokens.name: oat-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper raised surface for hover and pressed fills; keep body and soft text on it, not muted text.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card surface one step off the page background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on ivory, oat and card; also the fill of the primary button (ivory text on it).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text and ledes on ivory, oat and card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, kickers and captions on ivory and card; avoid it on oat-deep.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline between sections and list rows. Decorative: it separates, it never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: dot separators and underline rest colour. Decorative only (about 1.5:1).

tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: The one accent: focus ring, state, and the highlighter on prose links. Text in it reads on ivory and oat; on lapis-soft in light it is 4.13:1.

tokens.name: lapis-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected text and accent washes; pair with ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on ivory and danger-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for error messages; pair with danger text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on ivory and success-bg.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for success messages; pair with success text.

tokens.name: field-bg
tokens.usage: Background of text fields and selects.

tokens.name: body-ink
tokens.usage: Long-form body copy in posts, on ivory.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button (ink).

tokens.name: panel-bg
tokens.usage: Feature bands and banners: the inverse surface in light, a raised one in dark.

tokens.name: panel-fg
tokens.usage: Text on panel-bg.

tokens.name: tone-sky
tokens.usage: Neutral tint for illustration panels; the old hue names are kept but all are near-grey.

tokens.name: tone-sage
tokens.usage: Neutral tint for illustration panels.

tokens.name: tone-clay
tokens.usage: Neutral tint for illustration panels.

tokens.name: tone-mist
tokens.usage: Neutral tint for illustration panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Translucent hairline for frames and glass surfaces (ink at 8%).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of the ghost button and other outlined controls (ink at 14%).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Soft light behind the hero mark.

tokens.name: link-mark
tokens.usage: Highlighter swipe under links in posts and answers; the link text itself stays ink.

tokens.name: tizzle-blue
tokens.usage: A brand blue from the Tizzle studio, used on the cover as an accent block; not for interface state.

families.logo: "Plus Jakarta Sans", Montserrat, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page hero headline. The site scales it from 44px to 84px; 84px is the top of that range.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings (h2). The site scales it from 32px to 52px.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, in ink-soft, 40 characters wide at most. The site scales it from 18.4px.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, authors and other metadata in ink-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Small label above a headline, set in uppercase (apply text-transform in your CSS) in ink-muted.

styles.name: logo-word
styles.usage: The word Crooli beside the mark in the logo lockup, and nowhere else. Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold, loaded from Google Fonts (family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@800); size scales with the lockup, the 1.15rem here is the site header.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon-to-label nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, default gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large separation inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Largest step, between major bands.

tokens.name: wrap
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, with a gutter of 20px to 48px each side.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Focus ring corners, code chips, small controls.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Buttons and fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting lift on small surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Floating panels, menus and the glass header.
